verdict.rationale: HubSpot's docs state that a complete documentation index is published at https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/llms.txt and that appending .md to any docs page returns markdown. Fetched .md pages (account-types.md, get-account-details.md) confirm the markdown variants exist, and endpoint pages embed OpenAPI specs inline. The probe 404s at the root /llms.txt and /docs.md do not contradict the documented /docs/llms.txt path, but they show the .md convention is not uniform. Missing for 10: llms.txt at the conventional root location, /docs.md resolving, and independent or probe confirmation that /docs/llms.txt actually serves.
